newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SLOVNAFT SIGNS $250 MLN SYNDICATED LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SLOVNAFT SIGNS $250 MLN SYNDICATED LOAN.

text.p: The Slovak oil refiner Slovnaft a.s. said on Friday it had concluded a deal for a $250 million syndicated loan lead managed by Citibank International plc.

Co-arrangers of the credit, which comes without a state guarantee, are Ceskoslovenska Obchodna Banka a.s., Creditanstalt-Bankverein, The Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Limited , ING Barings, The Sanwa Bank Limited and Union Bank of Switzerland , Slovnaft said in a statement. The pricing on the loan was not disclosed.
Slovnaft will use the loan for financing so-called Environmental Fuel Project Apollo (EFPA), company said.
EFPA is a complex of production units for the conversion of heavy oil fractions with a high sulphur content into motor fuels and the production of low-sulphur heating oil.
Overall costs of the EFPA project are estimated at $500 million, $200 million of which would be secured mainly through a syndicated with Citibank.

So far, Slovnaft has signed one EFPA contract worth 15 million marks with the Dutch company Stork Comprimo for the construction of a desulphurisation unit to begin in the autumn. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-563-3687
